message:
We’ve all had those moments where we felt a little too prepared, haven’t we? 😏 It’s like when the weather turns unexpectedly, and you’re the one with an umbrella—everyone else is left scrambling! Having a well-thought-out survival kit is one of those things that can really make a difference in those scenarios we hope never happen.

The Red Cross has put together an excellent resource on essential supplies you might want to consider for your own kit. It’s a great reminder that being ready doesn’t have to be daunting; it can actually be empowering! 

What’s your go-to item for your emergency kit? We’d love to hear your tips!
